name: V-Rising
description: V Rising dedicated server. Windows depot via SteamCMD, run under GE-Proton. First boot downloads about 2GB and then builds a Proton prefix, which can sit quiet for several minutes before anything appears in the log. That is normal. The fields below are passed as launch options on every restart, so changing one and restarting takes effect. Your own edits to ServerHostSettings.json and ServerGameSettings.json are never overwritten - those are seeded once and then left alone. Anything without a field is still reachable: the server reads its own VR_ environment variables, so a variable named VR_FPS set to 45 sets the server framerate. See https://github.com/StunlockStudios/vrising-dedicated-server-instructions for the full list. The server saves when the container stops. Raise Unraid's container stop timeout to at least 75 seconds so the save is not cut off.

paths.name: Game Files
paths.description: Where the server, saves and settings live. Several GB - see Requires below.

paths.name: SteamCMD
paths.description: SteamCMD itself. Small, and shareable with other SteamCMD containers.

ports.name: Game Port
ports.description: Game traffic. UDP. This is the one to forward. To change it, set the Container Port, the Host Port and Server Port below all to the same number - Docker cannot tell the server what its host port is, so the three have to agree for the log to report the port players actually type. If something else on this box already listens on 27015, Docker refuses to start this container - change this port, or the other one. Unraid greys out that Container Port box for every port a template supplied, so you cannot type your number into it. To move this port, Remove this entry and add your own Port entry with the Container Port and the Host Port both set to your number - a port entry you create yourself has no container port yet, and Unraid leaves those editable. A template update can restore this entry alongside yours; remove it again. See the README.

ports.name: Query Port
ports.description: Steam server list traffic. Forward this too, or the server runs fine and never appears in the browser. If you move it, replace this entry the same way as Game Port above - see the README.

ports.name: RCON Port
ports.description: RCON. Only forward this if you administer the server from outside this box - anyone who reaches it and has the admin password controls the server.

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: The port the server binds. Keep it equal to Game Port above, both the Container Port and the Host Port.

variables.name: Server Query Port
variables.description: The query port the server binds. Keep it equal to Query Port above, both the Container Port and the Host Port.

variables.name: Server RCON Port
variables.description: The RCON port the server binds. Keep it equal to RCON Port above.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser. Applied on every restart.

variables.name: Save Name
variables.description: Name of the save directory. Changing this after first boot starts a NEW world - the old one stays on disk under save-data/Saves and can be switched back to by setting this name again. It does not rename anything.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player slots. 128 is the documented maximum. Applied on every restart.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Join password. Leave blank for an open server. Applied on every restart.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: RCON password. Leaving this blank disables RCON entirely, which is the safe default - the server still saves and shuts down cleanly without it. Set it only if you want to run admin commands.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Shown in the server browser's details panel, and printed in chat as players connect.

variables.name: Max Admins
variables.description: Admins allowed to connect even when the server is full.

variables.name: Game Settings Preset
variables.description: Load one of the presets shipped in VRisingServer_Data/StreamingAssets/GameSettingPresets, e.g. StandardPvP. Blank uses ServerGameSettings.json as it stands.

variables.name: Difficulty Preset
variables.description: Difficulty_Easy, Difficulty_Normal or Difficulty_Brutal. Blank leaves the setting alone.

variables.name: List on Steam
variables.description: Register on the Steam server list. true or false.

variables.name: List on EOS
variables.description: Register on the EOS server list, which is where the client looks by default. true or false.

variables.name: Secure Mode
variables.description: VAC protection. VAC banned clients cannot connect. true or false.

variables.name: Extra Game Parameters
variables.description: Appended to the launch line verbatim. Most settings do not need this - see the Overview about VR_ variables.

variables.name: Validate Files
variables.description: Set to true to have SteamCMD verify every file on the next start. Slow. Use it after a crash or a failed update.

variables.name: Debug Logging
variables.description: Turns on Proton and wine logging. Noisy and slows startup - use it when the server exits without writing any log of its own.

variables.name: Proton Version
variables.description: GE-Proton build to run the server under. This image is tested against GE-Proton10-34. A build the game does not tolerate fails silently, before any log is written - if that happens, set this back and delete the proton folder so the prefix is rebuilt.

variables.name: Stop Timeout
variables.description: Seconds to wait for a graceful save-and-exit before force killing. Also raise Unraid's own container stop timeout to match.

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Leave blank. The V Rising server downloads anonymously.

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Leave blank.

variables.name: UID
variables.description: User ID. 99 is the Unraid default.

variables.name: GID
variables.description: Group ID. 100 is the Unraid default.

variables.name: Data Permissions
variables.description: Mode applied to the top of the server directory.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: umask for files the server creates. 000 keeps them editable over the share.
